design.spice_loader: PLANETARY_EPHEMERIS_KERNELS = {'DE440': 'de440.bsp', 'DE421': 'de421.bsp'}; DEFAULT_PLANETARY_EPHEMERIS = 'DE440'; the selection is resolved as: explicit ephemeris= argument, else environment variable LUNAR_OD_PLANETARY_EPHEMERIS, else the default; required_kernels(ephemeris=None) returns the kernel list with the selected .bsp in the slot de421.bsp occupies today (load order otherwise unchanged, so the generic MOON_PA binding contract is untouched); REQUIRED_KERNELS stays a module constant equal to required_kernels() at import; required_kernel_paths and load_spice_kernels gain ephemeris=None; an unknown name raises
design.records: a test that fails under the new default only because it reproduces a DE421-era frozen record is pinned to DE421 explicitly (ephemeris='DE421' or the environment variable inside that test module), with a comment naming the record; every pinned test is listed in the report. Any other failure is investigated and reported, never pinned
design.not_changed: the gravitational constants kernel (gm_de431.tpc.txt; the DE440 GM file is not on disk - recorded as a limitation), the Earth orientation and lunar PA kernels, every estimator and propagator default (the D2 PropagationProfile default flip is deferred: the D2 adjudications are open and the profile costs 3-10x runtime; Phase E first)

gates.G1_de421_reproduction: with ephemeris='DE421' the loaded kernel list equals the pre-C4-I REQUIRED_KERNELS exactly, and spkezr('EARTH', et, 'J2000', 'NONE', 'MOON') at 25 epochs over 2025-2027 is bit-identical to the value from the pre-C4-I loader
gates.G2_de440_default: with defaults the loaded planetary kernel is de440.bsp, and the Moon-centred Earth position differs from the DE421 value by at most 5 m at those 25 epochs (C4 S2 measured <= 3.92 m on the KP2 span)
gates.G3_environment_override: LUNAR_OD_PLANETARY_EPHEMERIS=DE421 reproduces G1's values bit for bit; an unknown name raises ValueError
gates.G4_frame_contract: tests/test_de440_kernel_contract.py passes under the default (generic MOON_PA still binds to the DE421 realization; MOON_PA_DE440 resolvable)
gates.G5_suite_default: full pytest suite under the default: no failures other than tests pinned to DE421 per the records rule, each listed with its record
gates.G6_suite_de421: full pytest suite with LUNAR_OD_PLANETARY_EPHEMERIS=DE421 and the pins removed has the same pass set as the pre-C4-I branch (intermittent test_recorded_run_workspace excepted, as recorded in D2)

decision_rule: C4I_QUALIFIED if G1-G6 PASS; otherwise C4I_NOT_QUALIFIED with each failure reported as computed
